mentions.note: finished ahead of Simon Shanks in the 1,500 metres; probably the A.Pilcher of the table
aged 12; new club junior boys 800 metres record, equalled the 1,500 metre record; won 800 metres at the Brighton young athletes meeting in 2:31.4; at Bushey School, Raynes Park
